== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Strong Is Vader (Errata 2)]] (<code>1261_87</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 89), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published image shows this text: the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-89-Strong_Is_Vader.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-strongisvader-pre.gif]]) show PC-E1 ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata)]]); the first-copy slip ([[:File:VB6-89-Strong_Is_Vader-original-sheet.png]]) shows the original ([[Strong Is Vader]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive). The entry is labelled “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “If [Virtual] Mind What You have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and chose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_87</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 89 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-89-Strong_Is_Vader-PC-E2-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B10 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
